pages.text: The blast furnace does not melt iron alone: every recipe needs one item of $(item)flux$(), and in TFMG the flux is $(item)limesand$().$(br2)$(l)Getting limesand$()

1. Make Create $(item)limestone$(): let honey flow into flowing lava. A lava source turns into obsidian instead, so keep the lava flowing.$(br)2. Mine the limestone, ideally with a mechanical drill that breaks it as it forms.$(br)3. Send it through $(item)crushing wheels$(): each limestone block always gives $(item)1 limesand$().

$(l)What the blast furnace does with it$()$(li)$(item)Crushed raw iron + limesand$(): 144 mB of molten steel, 144 mB of molten slag and 200 mB of furnace gas.$(li)$(item)Raw iron + limesand$(): 288 mB of molten steel and 288 mB of slag, but it takes twice the time and hot air.
144 mB is one steel ingot in the casting basin. Plan about $(item)one limesand per steel ingot$() from crushed iron.$(br2)Limesand also makes $(item)cement$(), on the next page.
